conclusion: A rocprofv3 1.3.2 run with kernel, HIP, HSA, memory-copy, and KFD tracing reproduces the persistent gfx1151 low-power no-progress signature during the first 128K prefill, but emits no finalized trace files and cannot identify the final user kernel. Layer markers last retire layer 15 full attention in chunk [102400,106496); layer 16 linear attention returns on the host and its marker remains pending while the host is inside layer 17 linear attention, again producing a two-checkpoint lag with an unretired linear layer. At the same onset, rocprofiler-sdk's inline queue-interposition async handler begins repeatedly warning that it is still waiting on one injected HSA signal, reaching 153,092,096 polling iterations. This is consistent with an outstanding dispatch/completion that never retires, but it is not independent root-cause evidence: upstream rocprofiler-sdk work documents intermittent hangs in this inline queue-interposition path and recommends ROCPROFILER_QUEUE_INTERPOSITION=0 as a legacy-intercept workaround. The run therefore neither names a faulty hipEngine kernel nor proves the original stall is profiler-independent. A legacy-interposition retry or a streaming custom profiler is required for usable final-dispatch evidence.

rocprofiler_observation.interpretation: The profiler's injected completion signal stopped advancing at the same onset as the device no-progress signature. Because the active inline interposer has its own documented intermittent hang class, this can be either an observer of the original failure or an instrumentation-induced failure.

upstream_profiler_context.workaround: ROCPROFILER_QUEUE_INTERPOSITION=0 forces the legacy HSA queue interception path
upstream_profiler_context.signal_flush_smoke: A tiny completed marker process does flush CSVs on SIGINT under both inline and legacy interception; the stalled full-model inline process did not finalize, so output failure is tied to the outstanding queue signal rather than generic SIGINT handling.

decision.next_step: Retry once with ROCPROFILER_QUEUE_INTERPOSITION=0 and the same cached command, or implement a streaming rocprofiler-sdk callback that persists completed dispatch records before process finalization. Do not interpret trace-suppressed completion as stability.
